transcript.statement: Sustainability is crucial for modern software systems, particularly in reducing energy consumption and carbon footprint. GRN-01 through GRN-07 collectively ensure that the bookkeeping system is environmentally responsible. GRN-01 focuses on energy-efficient processing, while GRN-02 promotes cloud solutions to minimize carbon footprints. GRN-03 encourages digital practices to reduce paper waste. GRN-04 tracks resource impacts, GRN-05 provides users with sustainability metrics, GRN-06 offsets emissions, and GRN-07 ensures compliance with sustainability regulations. Together, these requirements enhance our commitment to sustainability without compromising functionality.

transcript.statement: Performance efficiency is vital for a bookkeeping system, ensuring that transactions are processed quickly and can handle multiple users simultaneously. Requirements EFF-01 to EFF-07 focus on optimizing responsiveness, throughput, and resource utilization. Specifically, EFF-01 ensures that transactions are processed swiftly, while EFF-02 guarantees support for concurrent users. EFF-03 minimizes memory usage, and EFF-04 ensures timely report generation. EFF-05 reduces latency through caching, EFF-06 ensures quick currency conversions, and EFF-07 emphasizes an efficient audit trail. These requirements collectively enhance user experience and system performance, which are crucial for financial operations.

transcript.statement: The security and privacy of financial data are paramount in a bookkeeping system. Requirements TRU-01 to TRU-07 collectively ensure robust data protection through encryption, role-based access control, immutable audit trails, data validation, two-factor authentication, and user access logs. These measures protect against unauthorized access and ensure data integrity, essential for maintaining user trust and compliance with financial regulations. Without these safeguards, the system could be vulnerable to data breaches and fraud, undermining its reliability and accountability.

transcript.statement: Safety and reliability are critical in a bookkeeping system to ensure accurate financial records and mitigate risks. SAF-06 validates currency conversions to prevent discrepancies, and SAF-07 emphasizes regular backups to safeguard against data loss. requirements.text: The system shall ensure compliance with sustainability regulations and standards relevant to financial systems, including energy-efficient processing methods and carbon offset options.
The system shall implement robust data protection measures including encryption, role-based access control, and two-factor authentication to secure financial data.
The system shall maintain an immutable audit trail of all transactions for a minimum of 7 years to ensure accountability and transparency.
The system shall ensure that all financial transactions are processed within 2 seconds while incorporating safety protocols and compliance checks.
The system shall validate data input and currency conversions to prevent unauthorized or erroneous transactions, ensuring data integrity.
The system shall integrate energy-efficient practices into report generation while ensuring timely processing for datasets up to 10,000 transactions.
The system shall log all user access and modifications to data, retaining logs for review to maintain accountability.
The system shall provide functionalities to detect and alert users about potential financial discrepancies or fraud.
The system shall provide user access controls to ensure that only authorized personnel can modify transactions, supporting accountability.
The system shall ensure safe degradation, allowing access to essential functionalities even during partial outages.
The system shall implement mechanisms for users to report ethical concerns or violations confidentially.
The system shall support multi-currency transactions with transparent exchange rates to ensure fairness in international transactions.
